name: email-channel
description: Two-way email channel over stdlib IMAP/SMTP. Converse with your agent by email, replies thread back, and results arrive in the same conversation. No streaming; approvals answer by reply token.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: IMAP Host
x-meta.help: IMAP server hostname for inbound mail (e.g. imap.gmail.com).

x-meta.label: IMAP Port
x-meta.help: 993 for implicit SSL (the default), usually 143 with Use SSL off (upgraded with STARTTLS).

x-meta.label: IMAP Username
x-meta.help: IMAP login, usually the full email address.

x-meta.label: IMAP App Password
x-meta.help: An app password from your mail provider, never your account password. Kept in the credential store and removed when you uninstall this app.

x-meta.label: IMAP SSL
x-meta.help: Connect with implicit TLS (IMAP4_SSL). Leave on for port 993. Off, the connection is upgraded with STARTTLS before the password is sent, and a server that does not offer STARTTLS is refused: the password is never sent in the clear.

x-meta.label: Folder
x-meta.help: IMAP folder to poll. Polled read-only — your mail is never marked read.

x-meta.label: SMTP Host
x-meta.help: SMTP server hostname for outbound mail (e.g. smtp.gmail.com).

x-meta.label: SMTP Port
x-meta.help: 587 for STARTTLS (the default), 465 for implicit SSL.

x-meta.label: SMTP Username
x-meta.help: SMTP login, usually the full email address.

x-meta.label: SMTP App Password
x-meta.help: Leave empty to reuse the IMAP app password, which is what one app password does at Gmail, Fastmail and iCloud. Kept in the credential store and removed when you uninstall this app.

x-meta.label: SMTP Security
x-meta.help: starttls (587) upgrades the connection before the login and the mail, and refuses a server that does not offer it or an upgrade that fails: nothing is sent in the clear. ssl (465) is implicit TLS. Any other value reads as starttls.

x-meta.label: CA Certificate File
x-meta.help: Only for a mail server whose certificate comes from your own certificate authority: the path to that authority's certificate (PEM). It is trusted as well as this machine's own authorities. The server's certificate and name are always checked, and a server nothing vouches for is refused before the password is sent.

x-meta.label: Mailbox Address
x-meta.help: The address this channel sends as and receives at. Defaults to the IMAP username. Also the self-message filter's anchor.

x-meta.label: Poll Interval (s)
x-meta.help: How often to check for new mail. Clamped to 10-3600s.

x-meta.label: Inbound Activation
x-meta.help: always answers every paired sender; off disables inbound while keeping outbound delivery.
